newsitem.title: UK: Ricardo sees future lift from Proton/Lotus.
newsitem.headline: Ricardo sees future lift from Proton/Lotus.

text.p: UK engineering and technologial services firm Ricardo Group said on Friday it hoped to reap some benefit from a deal by Malaysian car group Proton to buy a controlling stake in troubled UK sports car company Lotus.
"We consider that this will give a potential long-term benefit to our automotive businesses," chairman Sir Philip Foreman told shareholders at the annual meeting.
Notwithstanding "the challenges faced in the U.S.", the group said it was set to continue to make steady progress.
Foreman said he had noted with interest Proton's acquisition of 80 percent of Group Lotus' share capital earlier this week.

Ons of its units, Lotus Engineering, a specialist component, design, materials and manufacturing consultancy, competes with Ricardo in several areas. Proton has said it intends to apply some of these resources in its emerging Malaysian car plants.

Ricardo had been mentioned in several industry reports as a possible purchaser of all or part of Lotus during a prolonged period of uncertainty this year when Lotus's private owner Romano Artioli made clear he was seeking new investors.
